summary: Frontend testing complete for ConnectMe. Verified: new blue logo on nav + hero (/logo-mark.png), hero-logo-hub, eyebrow 'FIND PEOPLE • BUILD CONNECTIONS · 12 SCENES', 12 interests with 7 'Trending 2026' badges. Signed-out /messages shows PRIVATE MESSAGES prompt with messages-register-link. Signed in as Neha: sidebar + conversation-list + conversation-item-{raviId} render; thread-header shows Ravi, thread-privacy-note correct; sending via button and Enter key both appended right-aligned blue bubbles within ~3s. Switched to Ravi: Neha's messages appeared as left bubbles; nav-unread-count was 4 initially then dropped to 1 after opening Neha thread (correct — 1 remaining is from Aarav demo; update latency matches 8s poll). Directory member-card-message-btn navigates to /messages/{id} with thread-empty state; demo member Aarav auto-replies. Requests page shows request-card-message-link (href=/messages/{raviId}) and the confirmed meet-up still shows meetup-countdown + contact-reveal (regression OK). Register step1: reg-otp-mode-hint mentions Demo mode; after Send verification code, reg-otp-demo-code is shown; Verify + Continue advance to step 2 which has 12 reg-step2-interest-card-* and 7 reg-step2-trending-* badges. Mobile (390px): /messages/{id} shows thread only (sidebar display:none), thread-back-link returns to /messages list; hamburger menu reveals Interests/Directory/Requests/Messages. No console errors or page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Unread badge update latency up to ~8s due to polling interval (components/Nav UnreadBadge via lib/queries.ts). Acceptable but could feel laggy; consider optimistic client-side decrement when a thread is opened to make UX feel instant.
test_credentials: Profile tokens loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Neha Verma / Ravi Sharma). OTP demo code visible in reg-otp-demo-code.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral messages between Neha ↔ Ravi ('Hello Ravi from test …', 'Enter key test') and Neha ↔ Aarav ('Hi Aarav demo auto-reply test'). Aarav auto-replied as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend flows verified. If re-testing unread badge, allow 8-10s after opening a thread for nav-unread-count to update (poll interval). Mobile Playwright is_visible() may return False for a Messages link if multiple instances exist; verify visually or scope by menu container.
